stemMd: A machine makes one mark every 3 seconds, beginning with a mark at time zero. How many marks has it made by time 30 seconds, including a mark at exactly 30 seconds?
explanationMd: Marks occur at 0, 3, 6, …, 30 seconds. There are 30/3 = 10 intervals but eleven marked times because both endpoints count. Distinguishing intervals from events is the key step.

distractorRationale.b: This counts the intervals but omits the initial mark at time zero.
distractorRationale.d: This adds an extra mark beyond the two endpoints.
distractorRationale.e: This treats the mark rate as one per second.
